name: huddle
description: Multiplayer AI agents: a team and an agent research and write a doc together, live.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm run services:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.start: npm run services:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @huddle/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @huddle/shared && npm run build -w @huddle/api && npm run build -w @huddle/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @huddle/api && npm exec -w @huddle/web -- tsc -b --noEmit
scripts.services:up: docker compose -f apps/api/docker-compose.yaml up -d --wait db searxng
scripts.services:down: docker compose -f apps/api/docker-compose.yaml stop db searxng
scripts.services:logs: docker compose -f apps/api/docker-compose.yaml logs -f db searxng
